text:
The only arrangement that satisfies every constraint is Gus, Finn, Cara, Ben, Ann, Elif, Hana, Dev, Ivo.

Finn must sit immediately before Cara, and exactly one slot separates Cara from Gus, so the only legal block is Gus–Finn–Cara. Gus is before Ben with a gap of at least three, Ben is before Dev with a gap of at least three, and Dev is before Ivo. That chain forces Gus into slot 1 and Ben into slot 4, then Ann, Elif, and Hana into 5–7 and Dev, Ivo into 8–9. Every other placement breaks at least one gap or order constraint.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Elif","7":"Hana","8":"Dev","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
